session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Channel from Open, Wedge Top Reversal into Bear Channel' (overnight ET+13 hrs, Jan 5/6). Opening trading range with buying pressure, bull channel rally to a truncated wedge top (01:05 high 6963.75), support minor reversal pig mounts at 6948 (bar 36), double top in bear channel (red dotted 6956.5) and bear channel down all afternoon with failed double bottoms in bear channel, closing 6944.5. Inset: Back Inside Trading Range.
